question: Which classes in the retained two-dimensional strict block are rational on the original small elliptic quotient and its minus-one twist?
operations: One deterministic effort-zero PARI 2-descent and Cassels-pairing computation per fixed curve; retain its points, unconditional rank interval, and reported pairing rank. Then exact rational point checks and at most 32 point-word Kummer comparisons per curve against the two retained strict classes.
endpoint: Rational witnesses prove class solubility. A full-rank Kummer point subgroup plus a matching unconditional rank upper bound can prove absence of strict rational classes. Norm lifts alone are not point certificates.
failure: Keep an unresolved rank or class membership UNKNOWN. Do not raise effort, add curves, or increase the timeout.
